note: Multi-country competitions are deliberately absent: they have no single country and must not be forced into one. This includes continental competitions (UEFA Champions League, Europa League, Copa Libertadores, World Cup qualifiers) and domestic leagues with cross-border teams (MLS includes Canadian franchises). Residual collision risks: 'Bundesliga' (Austria), 'Serie A' (Ecuador), 'Premiership' (colloquial for England's league). These depend on exact ESPN emission strings and are mitigated by canonical-ID precedence in resolution.
adjectivesNote: ESPN prefixes many competitions with a nationality adjective instead of emitting a canonicalId (e.g. 'Argentine Liga Profesional de Futbol', 'English Carabao Cup'). Matched as a word-boundary prefix only ('Argentine ' at the start of the name) after the canonical-ID and alias lookups miss, never as a substring. Only unambiguous adjectives are listed; 'Irish' (Ireland vs Northern Ireland) and similar are deliberately omitted.
